split_reverse_split_merger_detection.repo_wide_search_performed: grep for corporate_action, stock_split, split_ratio, split_adjust, dividend_adjust, ex_date across every .py file in the repository
split_reverse_split_merger_detection.result: ZERO matches. No split-detection, no adjustment-reconciliation, no corporate-action event table, no delisting/merger handling exists anywhere in talonx_backtest, scripts/, or research/.

dividend_ex_date_handling_for_a_short_on.finding: Not modeled anywhere. A SHORT position open across a dividend ex-date owes the dividend to the share lender -- this is a real, unmodeled cost/liability for this specific SHORT-only candidate that raw OHLCV bars do not surface at all (a dividend does not itself cause a large single-bar price discontinuity the way a split does, but the LIABILITY still exists and is currently completely unaccounted for in any cost model in this repo).

known_public_corporate_actions_inside_th.source: General public market knowledge (widely reported), NOT verified against any price data in this repo -- no 2024 price bar was read to produce this entry.
known_public_corporate_actions_inside_th.impact_if_uncorrected: A raw/unadjusted price series would show an artificial ~90% single-bar price drop at the split date with no true economic return. Any 3-day cross-sectional return feature or any P&L calculation for a position spanning this date would be catastrophically wrong.
